name: atendara
description: SaaS multiprofissional de gestao e automacao para profissionais de atendimento.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.test:rules: node .local/firebase-tools/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-tests.json --project demo-atendara --only firestore "node scripts/test-firestore-rules.mjs"
scripts.test:repository: node .local/firebase-tools/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --config firebase.repository-tests.json --project demo-atendara --only firestore "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.mts"
scripts.test:emulator: npm run test:rules && npm run test:repository && npm run test:access
